    Property for sale in cape town, western cape

    Cape Town, also known as The Mother City is one of the most sought-after locations in Africa to invest in property. As a thriving and cosmopolitan city that boasts a crystal blue coastline, the iconic Table Mountain and a host of world class amenities, it’s easy to see why real estate moguls and investors alike jump at the chance to purchase property for sale in Cape Town.

    As the city is made up of several suburbs, you can choose between spacious ocean-view homes, bachelor apartments in the heart of the city or mountain facing estates. Alternatively, if you’re looking to raise a family in quieter surrounds, the southern and northern suburbs each have small and large properties readily available or even empty plots to build your dream home from scratch.

    A city that provides

    RE/MAX offers a collection of listings from Cape Town, each just as appealing as the next. Each suburb is home to a network of diverse individuals and families, making up a unique community. Residents are proud to call these areas home, as is evident by the meticulous care of the buildings and streets that surround them.

    Whether you’re looking for a holiday house or wanting to relocate from your current city, Cape Town is home to more than just beautiful property. In fact, as one of the leading tourist destinations in the world, alongside spectacular views, abundant wildlife and gourmet foods, choosing to become a resident here means you also gain access to:

    Public Transport

    Cape Town is home to an efficient network of trains, long-haul and city based busses and taxis, as well as major highways and paved roads, should you choose to travel via your own car. Aeroplane travel is also easily accessible for both international and local flights from Cape Town International Airport.

    Education

    Finding a school for your toddler, tween or teen is simple. There are several government and private institutions available in and around the city for pre, primary and high-school. Additionally, Cape Town also boasts internationally acclaimed tertiary institutions and exam facilities for many online learning platforms.

    Entertainment

    Depending on your preference, this is a city that caters for everyone. For those that prefer the outdoors, you have your pick from several Blue Flag beaches, hiking trails and public gardens. Alternatively, you have a choice between gourmet restaurants, high-end shopping malls, wine farms and a host of other activities to choose from.

    Professionalism at its best

    For over 40 years, RE/MAX agents have been helping people find their place to call home. From combing through each listing and showing you houses, right up to assisting with legalities to sign on the dotted line, your future is in good hands with one of our representatives.

    Contact RE/MAX today and tell us what you’re looking for. Don’t hesitate to be in touch if you want to sell a property in Cape Town too.

    About REMAX
    REMAX of Southern Africa, which was founded in 1995, is regarded as the pioneer of the REMAX international expansion as it was the first country franchise to be sold outside of North America. Locally, REMAX has over 3,000 agents operating from over 170 offices in 6 countries in Southern Africa.
